gates.title: Exact display power/straps and module revision
gates.required_evidence: Inspect manufacturer schematic page image, actual module; prove 5V input and no regulator contention.

gates.title: Mechanical parts and footprint/pad mapping
gates.required_evidence: Resolve NKK numerical pins, jack duplicate terminals, button feet, connector orderables and actuator heights.

gates.title: Native KiCad validation
gates.required_evidence: Open generated sheets, independently inspect connectivity and ERC; finalize footprint assignments and PCB routing; DRC and schematic parity.

gates.title: Input/protection qualification
gates.required_evidence: Test powered/unpowered faults, leakage, open-input bias, multiple channel injection, recovery and loading.

gates.title: Acquisition qualification
gates.required_evidence: Scope mux settling and ADC start, actual uniform sample cadence, missed-slot counters, alias response and cross-talk.

gates.title: Firmware/display integration
gates.required_evidence: Build with actual Pico SDK; integrate exact vendor bridge driver; verify ten panes, time/range, controls, HOLD and LINK.

gates.title: Power and USB budget
gates.required_evidence: Measure display backlight/inrush + Pico + analog rail; satisfy USB source contract and power sequencing.

gates.title: Exact sourcing and factory route
gates.required_evidence: Resolve every specification-only BOM row, external module/socket/knob supply, factory test and all soldering.

gates.title: Physical review
gates.required_evidence: Print panel at 100%; test real screen readability and control/cable clearance; accept stack and support.

gates.title: Release approval
gates.required_evidence: Generate BOM/CPL/Gerbers from final saved KiCad revision and explicitly approve quote. No current order export.
